description: Aventa AV-7 ETH Zurich Research Wind Turbine SCADA and high frequency Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Eleni Chatzi, Imad Abdallah (ETH Zürich). General description of wind turbine: The ETH owned wind turbine is Aventa AV-7, manufactured by Aventa AG in Switzerland and was commissioned in December 2002. The turbine is operated via a belt-driven generator and a frequency converter with a variable speed drive. Coverage: national (CH); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
